description: This file defines API routes for managing user files in a web application. It includes endpoints for listing files, uploading new files with validation, and deleting files, all integrated with Supabase storage and database with user-based access controls.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: list_files( session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list files associated with the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None, )
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload a new file for a session, with validation, storage, and metadata insertion.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a specific file owned by the user, both from storage and metadata.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a file associated with a specific session, ensuring ownership verification.

ctags.name: delete_file
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user), request: Request = None):$/
